Card ID.description: Allocated by scripts/allocate_ids.py from a content-derived identity. Do not hand-number.

Original Evidence.description: Backward-compatible convenience excerpt. Canonical source-preserving data belongs in Evidence Records.

Concept Key.description: Stable name of the claim/concept. Strongly recommended on every non-Concept Card: it is the primary input to the Card ID identity.

Status.description: Lifecycle state. Written by allocate_ids.py (default Active) and by afc-curate.

First Seen Run.description: Run id in which this identity first entered the registry.

Last Seen Run.description: Most recent run id that produced this identity.

Claim Key.description: Disambiguates several claims extracted from one source coordinate. Together with Concept Key this is what keeps a Card ID stable when the wording changes; without either, identity falls back to Title and the ID churns on every rewrite (allocate_ids.py reports this).

Semantic Domain Keys.description: Human-governed domain labels for discovery. They do not define product Scope or Card identity.

Semantic Domain Labels.description: Readable labels copied from the accepted Knowledge Domain registry for search and review.

Scopes.description: Multi-scope form of Scope; either may be used.
